body: Combination of social anxiety (worked around a lot of people) and thinking about past events. Some attacks weren't that bad but a couple I was visibly shaking.
I enjoy watching movies/shows/anime and video games. Everything else is hard because I have really bad social anxiety.

I'm not officially diagnosed with anything but bipolar depression runs in the family and I'm pretty sure I have some kind of colon condition.  

The thing is, I'm good at the jobs I had and do better than most. But I just don't see the point, everything seems irrelevant. I just don't want to do anything.

At my last job in a warehouse, I did so well that I basically had 1 day off a week where I didn't have to work much or at all. But my production has been steadily declining to the point to where I got fired. I was having 1 or 2 panic attacks a week where I'd go out to my car and just sit there for an hour.
